name: LiquidPlanner
description: LiquidPlanner is a predictive project-management and resource-planning platform built around priority, ranged estimates and capacity-aware scheduling. Teams organize work into workspaces, packages, projects, folders, tasks and assignments while LiquidPlanner forecasts timing and delivery risk.
agentUseSummary: Connect a customer-owned LiquidPlanner New API token. Selected agents can use five bounded workspace and plan-item actions under Safe or Dangerously skip permissions; descriptions, people, assignments, estimates, time and cost data, files, exports, Classic and raw API access remain unavailable.

credentialRequirements.name: LIQUIDPLANNER_API_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: LiquidPlanner API token
credentialRequirements.helpText: A separate bearer token owned by a dedicated least-authority LiquidPlanner New member and rotated regularly.

capabilities.label: Read workspaces
capabilities.description: List bounded workspaces available to the token owner.

capabilities.label: Read plan items
capabilities.description: List and inspect bounded plan-item metadata without descriptions, people or estimates.

capabilities.label: Manage plan items
capabilities.description: Create minimal tasks and name-check plan-item renames.

approvalRequired.label: List workspaces
approvalRequired.description: List at most twenty workspaces available to the token owner.

approvalRequired.label: List plan items
approvalRequired.description: List at most twenty metadata-only plan items in one exact workspace.

approvalRequired.label: Read plan item
approvalRequired.description: Read bounded metadata for one exact plan item.

approvalRequired.label: Create task
approvalRequired.description: Create one minimal task under one exact parent item.

approvalRequired.label: Rename plan item
approvalRequired.description: Rename one exact plan item after its current name matches.

blocked.label: Administer organizations or workspaces
blocked.description: Organizations, workspaces, members, resources, placeholders, roles, tokens, billing and settings are unavailable.

blocked.label: Change advanced plan data
blocked.description: Descriptions, dates, estimates, priorities, status, custom fields, assignments, dependencies and item movement are unavailable.

blocked.label: Access people or financial data
blocked.description: Members, assignments, time entries, timesheet notes, cost codes, billing rates and pay rates are unavailable.

blocked.label: Access files or exports
blocked.description: Files, attachments, timesheet exports and grid downloads are unavailable.

blocked.label: Use LiquidPlanner Classic
blocked.description: The legacy app.liquidplanner.com API and Classic credentials are outside this connection.

blocked.label: Run arbitrary LiquidPlanner calls
blocked.description: Agents cannot choose origins, paths, raw filters, continuation tokens, fields or request bodies.

blocked.label: Run bulk or unbounded operations
blocked.description: Bulk mutation, recursive tree walks, duplication, deletion, exports and responses above twenty rows or 256 KiB are unavailable.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Private reads and both mutations require approval. Fixed origin, token-owner authority, bounds, field allowlists, name checks, redaction and audits always apply.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All five selected actions run without Relay per-action approval; fixed origin, token authority, bounds, field allowlists, name checks, redaction and audits still apply.

providerSetup.blocker: LiquidPlanner New API access requires a paid Ultimate organization and an Org Admin must create and assign the non-expiring API token from Administration > API Access.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console acceptance task, use a synthetic LiquidPlanner New workspace, assign a separate token to a dedicated least-authority member, verify the five bounded tools and permission denials, then disable and delete the token.

evidence.supports: LiquidPlanner documents the New API, fixed next.liquidplanner.com surface, paid Ultimate requirement, bearer tokens and supported plan-item operations.
Tokens inherit the active owner member's workspace, plan-item and edit authority; LiquidPlanner recommends a separate API user and says tokens do not expire.
The official workspaces endpoint returns authorized workspace IDs and names.
The official items endpoint documents filtered reads, minimal task creation and name updates alongside much broader fields that Relay blocks.
LiquidPlanner documents case-sensitive limit and continuation-token pagination; Relay fixes the limit at twenty or fewer and blocks caller continuation tokens.
